title_highlights: 美国石油储备降至43年新低
特朗普试图限制伊朗危机影响
霍尔木兹海峡复航仍需数周

subtitles.en: The president already mentioned one of the issues. The idea that you still need to clear the straight of minds.
subtitles.zh: 总统已经提到了一个问题，即仍需清理霍尔木兹海峡。

subtitles.en: We all know the straight could be declared open, but Intel commercial vessels decide that it is safe to transit and they're willing to take the risk.
subtitles.zh: 我们都知道海峡可以宣布开放，但商业船只需自行判断是否安全并愿意冒险。

subtitles.en: It won't really be open in the same way that it was before.
subtitles.zh: 它不会像以前那样真正开放。

subtitles.en: Set your realistic expectations here for us if you would.
subtitles.zh: 请为我们设定现实的预期。

subtitles.en: Yeah, no, that's right, Kaleen. It's great to be back with you.
subtitles.zh: 是的，没错，Kaleen。很高兴再次与你交流。
en_highlights: great to be back with you

subtitles.en: I think the administration is expecting it. It's reasonable. It's Rapidans base case.
subtitles.zh: 我认为政府对此有预期，这是合理的，也是Rapidans的基本假设。

subtitles.en: That it'll take through the end of this month before it's really safe and clear for those boats to start moving through hormones again.
subtitles.zh: 预计要到本月底，船只才能安全、畅通地再次通过霍尔木兹海峡。

subtitles.en: You've got to sign the agreement. You've got to get the insurance in place.
subtitles.zh: 必须签署协议，并落实保险。

subtitles.en: And then you have to make sure the channels are clear of minds that have been boats moving down from Europe and the United States ready to do that.
subtitles.zh: 然后要确保航道中没有水雷，来自欧洲和美国的船只已准备好行动。

subtitles.en: So I think everyone's going to move along. And the market will price in.
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为一切都会推进，市场也会相应定价。

subtitles.en: It is pricing in arguably. The good news is almost all end, I think, that it's going to happen.
subtitles.zh: 市场正在消化这一消息。可以说，好消息几乎都结束了，我认为这将会发生。
en_highlights: good news is almost all end

subtitles.en: So I wouldn't sweat too much that it's going to take a couple weeks for things to pick up as the president pointed out and it's fair.
subtitles.zh: 所以我不太担心，正如总统所说，事情需要几周时间才能好转，这是合理的。

subtitles.en: The White House and DOD have arranged to get more boats out than many expected, well over 20 in the last few days and weeks and so forth.
subtitles.zh: 白宫和国防部安排派出的船只比许多人预期的要多，过去几天和几周内超过了20艘。

subtitles.en: So a trickle will become a stream if all goes well, if the MOU sticks.
subtitles.zh: 所以，如果一切顺利，如果谅解备忘录得以维持，涓涓细流将变成洪流。

subtitles.en: Well, of course, those are some pretty big ifs.
subtitles.zh: 当然，这些都是相当大的假设。
